html:
G'oya

Har bir vazifani kunlarga yoyamiz: boshlanish kunidan tugash kunigacha har bir kun alohida qator. Keyin har bir kunni tekshiramiz: hafta kuni dam olish emasmi va holidays da yo'qmi. Ish kunlarini sanash qoladi.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH RECURSIVE days(id, d, end_date) AS (
  SELECT id, start_date, end_date FROM tasks
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, d + 1, end_date FROM days WHERE d < end_date
)
SELECT id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM d) NOT IN (0, 6)
                 AND d NOT IN (SELECT h.day FROM holidays h) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS work_days
FROM days
GROUP BY id

Har bir vazifaning kamida bitta kuni (start_date) days da bor, shuning uchun hamma vazifa natijaga chiqadi. Shart WHERE da emas, SUM(CASE ...) ichida, aynan shu sababli: "Dam olish kunlari navbatchiligi" kabi vazifa 0 bilan qoladi.

Tuzoqlar

Shartni WHERE ga yozsangiz, ish kuni yo'q vazifaning hamma qatori o'chadi va vazifa natijadan yo'qoladi.

Avval dam olish kunlarini, keyin oraliqdagi bayramlarni alohida ayirish. 2024-09-01 yakshanba va bayram, u ikki marta ayiriladi: 2024-08-30 dan 09-02 gacha 2 ish kuni o'rniga 1 chiqadi.

Noto'g'riWITH RECURSIVE days(id, d, end_date) AS (
  SELECT id, start_date, end_date FROM tasks
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, d + 1, end_date FROM days WHERE d < end_date
)
SELECT t.id,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM days x WHERE x.id = t.id AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM x.d) NOT IN (0, 6))
     - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holidays h WHERE h.day BETWEEN t.start_date AND t.end_date) AS work_days
FROM tasks t

Dialektlar farqi

SQLite'da hafta kuni strftime('%w', d), u matn qaytaradi. NOT IN (0, 6) deb son bilan solishtirsangiz, '0' hech qachon 0 ga teng bo'lmaydi va dam olish kunlari ham ish kuniga qo'shiladi. Qo'shtirnoq kerak:

Faqat SQLiteWITH RECURSIVE days(id, d, end_date) AS (
  SELECT id, start_date, end_date FROM tasks
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id, date(d, '+1 day'), end_date FROM days WHERE d < end_date
)
SELECT id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', d) NOT IN ('0', '6')
                 AND d NOT IN (SELECT h.day FROM holidays h) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS work_days
FROM days
GROUP BY id

PostgreSQL'da EXTRACT(DOW ...) yakshanbani 0 deydi, EXTRACT(ISODOW ...) esa 7. Ikkisini aralashtirib NOT IN (6, 7) yozsangiz, yakshanbalar ish kuni bo'lib qoladi.
